stop.no_reply: ⏸ No reply for {minutes} min — stopping and switching AFK off. Everything done so far is saved.
stop.stopped: ✅ AFK off. The session is waiting for you at the keyboard.
stop.status:
📊 AFK active · project {project} · turn {turn}/{max} · session closes in {minutes} min.
Commands: /back — switch off, /status — this report.
perm.timeout: ⏳ No answer — the request went to the computer screen, the session is waiting there.
perm.denied: The user denied this call from Telegram. Do not retry it — propose another route or ask what to do next.
perm.stopped: ✅ AFK off. The permission prompt stayed on screen.
perm.unclear: 🤔 I need “yes” or “no” — for this request ({tool}).
ctl.started:
🚶 AFK on · project {project}

The conversation continues here: every finished turn lands in this chat, and your message becomes the next turn in the session.

• plain text — continues the conversation
• yes / no — answers a permission request
• /status — where we are
• /back — switch AFK off

Limits: {max_turns} turns, wait up to {wait} min for a reply, session closes in {hours} h.
ctl.stopped: ✅ AFK switched off from the computer.
ctl.on_summary:
AFK is on. Project: {cwd}. Limits: {max_turns} turns, {wait} min wait, {hours} h cap.
Check Telegram — the start message should be there.
ctl.setup_hint:
AFK is not configured: no Telegram bot yet.

Run this in YOUR OWN terminal (not through Claude — the token must not land in the transcript):

    python3 {setup} 

Before that, create the bot: Telegram → @BotFather → /newbot → copy the token, then open your bot and press Start (a bot cannot message you first).
setup.intro:
AFK Telegram bridge setup
-------------------------
Before you start:
  1. Telegram → @BotFather → /newbot → pick a name and a username (…bot)
  2. Copy the token, it looks like 1234567890:AA...
  3. Open your new bot, press Start and send it any message
     (a bot cannot write to you first — Telegram forbids it)
setup.bad_token: That does not look like a token. Expected format: 1234567890:AA...

  Check it in @BotFather.

setup.no_chat: Without a chat_id the bridge cannot work.
